question: Can an unauthenticated first-party SSE endpoint enumerate a broad current ETF listing cohort by objective family/status fields?

conclusion.headline: SSE FUND_LIST can enumerate a broad live listing snapshot by fundType/subClass and pagination. It cannot establish a date-specific status-qualified, eligible, or executable ETF cohort.
permitted_use: Identifier seed for later independent research.
prohibited_use: Claiming a legally or historically complete all-current-SSE-ETF universe.
Product selection, allocation, holdings, orders, or return conclusions.
Point-in-time total-return, corporate-action, tax, rights, or execution analysis.

ambiguities: The full 893 rows were not archived; only two master pages and four partition pages were captured.
No server-side snapshot ID, as-of timestamp, or stable cursor is supplied; a full live pagination run can drift.
pageHelp.data and top-level result duplicate the same rows; downstream collection must consume one only.
The response has subClass codes but no textual codebook; code labels must be independently versioned.
Partition equality supports no incremental count from subClass 04 in this capture, not a permanent zero or formal-taxonomy completeness claim.

field_assessment.conditional: INDEX_CODE and INDEX_NAME were populated in master/equity/bond/cross-border samples and blank in all commodity sample rows.
missing: Explicit status, lifecycle, suspension/resumption, and delisting fields.
Source as-of timestamp/version and historical/effective-dated membership.
Price, NAV, IOPV, liquidity, shares/float, fund size, market maker, fees, and holdings.
Distribution, corporate-action, index-change, creation/redemption, merger, termination, and other dated events.
Investor/account eligibility, broker access, quota, settlement/currency route, tax, and subscription/redemption rights.

limitations.pit: No as-of/version, historical membership, effective-dated classification, or lifecycle status; cannot establish a survivorship-free formation/rebalance universe.
limitations.events: No dated distributions, cash, splits, mergers, terminations, index changes, creations/redemptions, suspensions/resumptions, or market-status history; cannot reconcile total return.
limitations.rights: No verified investor classification, brokerage permission, account eligibility, quota, settlement/currency, tax, or primary-market entitlement.
limitations.execution: No tradeable price, NAV/IOPV, bid/ask, depth, volume, market status, lot, T+1/no-fill, limits, commission, slippage, fill, or capacity information.

warnings: Endpoint-returned totals are live response metadata, not a frozen full-universe archive.
Raw HTTP-body and stored-file hashes are both documented in the source manifest because local text storage adds one terminal LF.
No fallback source and no challenge body were used.

next_gate: Obtain an authorized or independently archived PIT listing-status source, dated events/corporate actions, price/NAV and market-status data, rights confirmation, and cost/liquidity evidence before any use beyond discovery.
